content:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for service `inference-api` (rev=v2.14.0) in us-east-1. Canary %: 10% :rocket:

sam: heads-up — I'm seeing a jump in 5xxs on the canary shards, starting ~40s after rollout. rolling window 1m -> 3.2% (baseline ~0.02%).

maya: I see that too. tracing UI is returning blank for the canary span group, looks like traces aren't getting instrumented for that rev. dashboard panel for `inference.latency.p50` is empty for canary tag.

jordan: paging oncall now. this might be a bad kernel change in the runtime. @maya can you confirm if this is customer impacting?

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: @maya (primary), @sam (secondary). Incident created: INC-2026-1123. Severity: P2.

maya: remote checks: curl against canary leader returns 200 but body is an error proto for some requests: `{\"error\":\"kv-cache-miss\"}` — not consistent. rate-limited?

sam: grabbing logs. quick repro from one of canary pods shows this loop: 
```
2026-03-10T14:13:27Z inference-api[pid=7]: warn: kv cache miss for key=ctx-0x7f3a
2026-03-10T14:13:27Z inference-api[pid=7]: error: streaming write failed: broken pipe
2026-03-10T14:13:28Z inference-api[pid=7]: error: downstream call 502 from tokenizer
```

nina: fwiw, the canary tagging in prometheus was `env=canary-2026-03-10` but our dashboards are keyed on `canary=true`. metrics were scraped but panels didn't match labels -> empty graphs. that's why we didn't notice p50 rising in the usual dashboard.

jordan: so two issues: (1) app-level errors in this build, (2) observability mismatch (label/tag mismatch) hiding metrics.

maya: mitigation suggestion: flip the kill-switch for canary routing (FF: `canary_router_enabled`) to 0, pause rollout, and rollback rev if errors persist. also add a quick patch to metric relabeling so dashboards show canary label.

sam: agreed. I'm going to disable the feature flag for the rollout now. executing: `curl -X POST https://flags.internal/ff/canary_router_enabled -d '{"value":false}'`

deploy-bot: Feature flag update propagated to routing layer. Canary traffic reduced to 0% :white_check_mark:

maya: confirming customer impact: from metrics we have ~2% of Generate requests during the 4m window returned 5xx with errors. Volume low but some enterprise customers saw failures. tagging SREs for customer-facing notifications.

jordan: notify support and product about possible rollback + customer impact. Nina — can you take a quick count and summarize affected customers (id list)?

nina: on it. initial scan shows 7 customers with >1 failed request, 2 with >5 errors. I'll post list in private channel.

sam: rolling back to rev v2.13.9 now (triggered rollback job). logs show rollback job started.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for inference-api -> target rev: v2.13.9. Estimated completion ~30s.

oncall-bot: Reminder: add `observability` tag to the incident and schedule a 1hr postmortem triage.

maya: postmortem checklist notes:
- root cause suspicion: regression in runtime KV/cache interactions introduced in v2.14.0 leading to transient downstream errors.
- visibility issue: metric label naming inconsistency (`canary-YYYY-MM-DD` vs `canary=true`) prevented dashboards and alerting from surfacing p50/p95 spikes.
- alert noise: when SLO burn started, alert routing matched a flappy `request-errors` alert that had low precision; alerts fired but belonged to a different tag namespace.

sam: immediate action items assigned:
- sam: confirm rollback fully completed and prod traffic stable.
- maya: own incident, coordinate with runtime eng to bisect v2.14.0 changes.
- nina: customer impact report for support + postmortem.
- jordan: patch relabel rules in prometheus and update dashboards to accept both `canary=true` and `env=canary-*` labels.

maya: handing off - I need to take a short break. @sam you can own until I get back.

sam: taking over. I'll keep channel updated.

jordan: quick note for triage: add a synthetic test that hits the canary label permutations during future rollouts, and gating rule to fail canary if 5xx > 0.5% in 1m window.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed, inference-api serving rev=v2.13.9 in all regions. Healthchecks green.

sam: prod 5xx back to baseline. will watch for 15m.

nina: sending initial customer notification now with apology + mitigation note.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-1123 updated to status: stabilizing. Assigned to: maya.

maya: thanks everyone. postmortem to be scheduled tomorrow. Main follow-ups: runtime fix, dashboard relabel, alert tuning.

sam: tl;dr for pager: bad canary build -> partial customer errors -> roll forward blocked by missing observability -> kill flag + rollback -> stabilize.

jordan: add a note to runbook: "on canary deploys, verify label mapping in prometheus and that p50 panel is populated before moving beyond 10% traffic".

sam: closing channel for now, will reopen if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
